# Uncle Kam

> > AI-powered tax strategy platform delivering legal tax savings through the MERNA™ Method and certified tax professionals nationwide.

Uncle Kam is a network of MERNA™ certified tax strategists offering AI-enhanced tax planning, preparation, and advisory services. The platform specializes in maximizing deductions, optimizing entity structures (LLC, S-Corp), and providing year-round tax guidance for business owners, self-employed professionals, real estate investors, and high net worth individuals.
